open_obligations.what_is_open: In the residual triangular-array wedge \(b\ll u\ll1\) and \(b\ll\sigma^2\ll1\), it remains open whether a realization-wise radius-constrained, hypothesis-dependent paired-cell fuzzy experiment can attain ATE separation of order \(M\min\{\sigma,d/[n\log(en)]\}\) at sample-mixture total variation bounded away from one, or whether an explicit total estimator can improve in order on \(M^2\{b+\min(u,\sigma^2)\}\), ideally down to \(M^2(b+\sigma^2u)\).
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen theorems give only the two-sided bracket \(c_{\epsilon}M^2(b+\sigma^2u)\le\mathsf R_{n,d,\epsilon,M,\sigma}\le C_{\epsilon}M^2\{b+\min(u,\sigma^2)\}\) in this wedge.  A cell- and hypothesis-independent channel cannot attain the larger requested separation because the radius restriction forces its binary-input mean contrast to be at most \(2\sigma M\).  The tested hypothesis-dependent centered mixed-arm factorial lift has the desired population approximation, but on a valid exact-homogeneity Rademacher submodel its singleton treated--control pairs force variance at least order \(\log^2(em)/m\), rather than the required order \(m^{-1}\).  These are architecture-specific impossibility certificates and therefore do not rule out a different coupled fuzzy experiment or a nonlinear noise-suppressing estimator.
open_obligations.attempted: First, the binary one-arm lower-bound family was passed through a general treatment-dependent Markov channel that is nevertheless common to all cells and both hypotheses; linearity plus a supported equal-mass two-cell test law proves that every such channel yields at most product separation \(O(M\sigma d/[n\log(en)])\).  Second, a centered mixed-arm reciprocal-polynomial construction was analyzed: its exact population identity yields squared approximation error \(O_{\epsilon}(u\{\sigma^2+(t-\tau/M)^2\})\), but an oracle-pilot Rademacher calculation exposes an unavoidable degree-zero singleton-pair diagonal for that linear lift.  Sample splitting, oracle centering, and the weak conditional-second-moment envelope do not remove this diagonal.
